description: BuildingSystems is a free and open-source Modelica library for energy-related building and plant simulation. It is developed at the Berlin University of the Arts (UdK Berlin) and is one of the four libraries built on the shared Modelica IBPSA Library core, so its models follow the same conventions as AixLib, IDEAS and the Modelica Buildings Library. Coverage is generic. It is distributed as Modelica source on GitHub with a user guide and a mailing list; the README states that the library is still under heavy development and that no release has been published yet, and the default branch was last changed in July 2026. Licence: BSD 3-clause, free of charge. Caveats: no tagged release exists, so users work from the development branch and models may change; a Modelica environment is required. Simulation uses are building and plant energy simulation for design and capacity planning. Related records: Modelica IBPSA Library (core), AixLib, IDEAS and Modelica Buildings Library (sister libraries).
